items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Now, Marlowe Morris is sitting between them... He had reached over Marlow and grabbed the steering wheel

ctx.x: Now, Marlowe Morris is sitting between them. Marlow didn't know how to drive. He said, "Well, come on, Sid, you're going to learn how to drive tonight." So he gets Sid over. Now, we're right there by the UP station, the old train station there at 5th and Central. All right. Gets Sid on the wheel, Sid starts smiling, clutching the wheel like it's a gift to him, you know, someone has just given him something for Christmas. You know how he was. Oh, goody, goody.

Zoot So tells him where the ignition is, how to shift, clutch, out on clutch, out on the other one. Sid did this, started off, got up a little steam, and two blocks up we can see this signal changing. Red light pops up. Zoot says, "Put (laughs) on the brakes, Sid." Sid says, "Brakes?" I went under the seat. He had showed him everything. He kept telling him, "The other one, the other one." He didn't tell him the brake. He had reached over Marlow and grabbed the steering wheel, you know, and ended up in the gas…
Let's get back to some music.
